name: io.github.sepehr071/digistyle-mcp
title: Digistyle Fashion
description: Read-only Digistyle (digistyle.com) fashion store: search, filters, product details, brands, deals.

environmentVariables.name: DIGISTYLE_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Digistyle requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
